title: docs(skills): teach the {current_iso_week} period key in the query filter rules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEoKvgs2TW7hc47KRGVnwtY)_
Fixes #35496

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：装了查询技能的 AI 写筛选条件时，会知道「本 ISO 周」周键占位符是什么、只能用在存周键的文本字段上、用在日期字段会被拒绝。
- 为什么做：「本 ISO 周周键」这个占位符已经上线，对外发布的查询技能说明还没写，属于「技能文档跟上平台」这一批。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明文字和一条评测样例，不动运行时；写错了 AI 会给出错的筛选写法，直接撤回这个改动即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`, section "Date Macros (declarative filter metadata)":

- A new **Period key** paragraph beside the date-macro bullets and the session tokens: `{current_iso_week}` is a member of `PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS`, not a date macro; it resolves to today's ISO week key `YYYY-Www` in the workspace time zone, Monday-start weeks, ISO week-year at year edges (2027-01-01 is `2026-W53`); it is text, for a text field storing week keys; a `date` / `datetime` / `time` field refuses it with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 like the literal key, and the date-field spelling is `{current_week_start}` / `{current_week_end}`; a date dashboard filter's `defaultValue` and `calendar.initialDate` refuse it, a text dashboard filter may default to it; there is no last- or next-week key.
- The session-token example now carries the week key on a text field (`cost_week: '{current_iso_week}'`).
- **Scope** names `resolveFilterPlaceholders()` as the client resolver, the one call over `resolveDateMacros()`, `resolvePeriodKeyTokens()` and `resolveContextTokens()`.
- The spelling check is `isKnownFilterToken(tok)`, the one predicate that answers for all three vocabularies. The two predicates the file named before both answer `false` for `current_iso_week`, so leaving them would have contradicted the new paragraph.

`skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json`: eval 10, a text week-key field filtered with the token and a date field filtered with the week's boundaries, never with the token.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `filters.md` row moves 2473 to 2596, the measured remainder (see the budget below).

`.changeset/35496-skills-filters-iso-week-key.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

Read first, by risk:
1. `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`, the **Period key** paragraph (the risky hunk: every clause is a claim about the runtime, sourced below).
2. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, the comment over the `filters.md` row (the deletion list and the arithmetic).
3. `skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json`, eval 10.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, expected line `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md is 2596 tokens (ceiling 2596; headroom 0)` and a passing verdict.

### Each sentence and where main says it (origin/main 598a34d04)

| Sentence in the skill | Source on main |
|:---|:---|
| a list of its own, not a date macro | `packages/spec/src/data/date-macros.zod.ts:62-67` and `:179-181` (`PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS`), `:190-192` |
| `YYYY-Www`, workspace time zone, Monday-start weeks, ISO week-year | `packages/spec/src/data/date-macros.zod.ts:69-74` and `:344-348`; server resolver `packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts:471-473` |
| 2027-01-01 is `2026-W53` | `packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.test.ts:568` (parity table row), spec prose `date-macros.zod.ts:72` |
| text, for a text field storing week keys | `date-macros.zod.ts:75-80`; positive control `packages/objectql/src/engine-temporal-comparand-door.test.ts:646-647` |
| `date` / `datetime` / `time` refuse it, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, like the literal key | `packages/objectql/src/engine-temporal-comparand-door.test.ts:621-641` (both wrappings, code and status asserted, the literal `2026-W47` in the same loop); over HTTP `packages/rest/src/data-temporal-write-real-day-iso.test.ts:385` |
| use `{current_week_start}` / `{current_week_end}` on a date field | `date-macros.zod.ts:133` (the two tokens); the same door test's title and its positive control |
| a date dashboard filter's `defaultValue` refuses it, a text one may default to it | `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.test.ts:506-518`; `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:1663-1676` |
| `calendar.initialDate` refuses it | `packages/spec/src/ui/calendar-config-initial-date.test.ts:94` |
| both spellings, in every vocabulary | `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts:255` (the same wrapper pattern); `filter-tokens.test.ts:603-604` |
| client resolver `resolveFilterPlaceholders()` over the three | `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts:301-308`; exported at `ui/packages/core/src/index.ts:221-234` |
| `isKnownFilterToken(tok)` | `packages/spec/src/data/context-tokens.zod.ts:333-335`; listed in `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json:1057` |
| no last- or next-week key | `PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS` has one member (`date-macros.zod.ts:179-181`) |

Whole-value only (card item 4, last sentence) is true on main (`filter-tokens.test.ts:607` and `:616`, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts:255`) and is not written again: the section's "Unknown tokens" paragraph already says a value that merely contains braces is a literal, for every token.

### Token and line budget

Standing ruling for `skills/**`, quoted verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (maintainer, 2026-10-27; ruling record 6513306068).

Deleted first, all in the same section of `filters.md`:
1. The wrapper regex in the "Both spellings parse" bullet, which restated in pattern form the sentence it sat in.
2. The code comment `// List-view / dashboard filter values`, which repeated the sentence above its block.
3. The second date-macro comparison in the session-token example (`close_date` with `{current_year_start}`), a second showing of what the first block shows; the week key takes its place.
4. The two per-vocabulary predicates, replaced by the one predicate.
5. The driver sentence's list of value kinds ("ISO strings and concrete ids"), now "resolved values".

## Tests

Text only; no package source changes, so no package test or ablation is owed. Local readings at head 47fe01057:

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, `59 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `104 cases pass` (the script this diff edits).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-served-sections`: each `VERDICT command-exit 0` under the verify lock.
- `pnpm check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:role-word`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-declaration-mirrors.mjs`, `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`: exit 0 each.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (one open pull shares the ratchet script and merges cleanly).

NOT MEASURED: `check:skill-examples`, reason: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, it reads built output and this worktree has none; the blocks this diff touches are `where` fragments the gate skips by the file's own opening note. CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- Search for contradictions in `skills/objectstack-query/`: `current_week` has no hit outside the new text; `week` outside `filters.md` hits once, `rules/aggregation.md:83` ("weeks are ISO-8601, starting Monday"), which agrees. `current_iso_week` had no hit under `skills/` before this diff.
- Left out, on purpose: the `this_week` preset the card offers as a date-field alternative. It is a date-range preset name, and where a preset is a legal filter comparand is a separate rule this pull did not measure; the two boundary tokens are the measured spelling.
- Left out: `$contains` with the token on a text field also resolves (door test line 648). True, and not worth its tokens.
- The server reads the request's reference time zone (`filter-tokens.ts:172`, default UTC when the request carries none); the skill says "workspace time zone", the wording of the spec's own description table.
- The section's opening ("compute the date yourself" for ad-hoc queries) and its Scope paragraph ("use tokens in a hand-issued engine query too") pull in different directions. Older text, not changed here.

## Verification

`dispatch-gates --ran`: 19 of 65 derived families run locally; the 46 others are declared to CI. They are matched by the edit to one `scripts/*.mjs` ceiling row (script-population gates) or are whole-tree families; none reads the skill text.
